<!--
  A call to action with proof: a badge, the heading, a lead, the proof, one or two actions and an optional note.

  features, stats, rows, zones), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { CtaContent } from "./cta-proof.types";
  import type { Logo } from "./logo-cloud.types";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
  import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
  import type { Zone } from "./zone-table.types";
  import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

  export type CtaProofProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    actions: LinkActions;
    content: CtaContent;
    note?: string;
    layout?: "center" | "split";
    proof?: "logos" | "features" | "stats" | "rows" | "zones";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import CtaProofItems from "../components/cta-proof-items.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    actions,
    content,
    note = "",
    layout = "center",
    proof = "stats",
    mediaSide = "end",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: CtaProofProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={lead}
  heading={{ badge }}
  tone={tone}
  align={(((layout as string) === "center") ? "center" : "start")}
  layout={(((layout as string) === "center") ? "stack" : "split")}
  media={{ show: ((layout as string) === "split"), side: mediaSide }}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  <CtaProofItems content={content} proof={proof} center={((layout as string) === "center")} />
  <ActionGroup
    primary={actions.cta}
    primaryHref={actions.href}
    secondary={((actions.mode === "two") ? actions.secondary : undefined)}
    secondaryHref={actions.secondaryHref}
    align={(((layout as string) === "center") ? "center" : "start")}
  />
  {#if note}
    <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground" data-testid="cta-note">
      {note}
    </Text>
  {/if}
  {#snippet aside()}
    <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
  {/snippet}
</SectionFrame>
